Hi team,

Summary: this thread captures the pre-PIP coaching plan and evidence trail for Jordan Hayes (Eng IC, Platform). Over the past two quarters Jordans output and cross-team follow-through have tripped multiple deadlines (see bullets below). Im initiating a structured 4-week coaching plan to give clear expectations and documented checkpoints before any formal HR action.

Key concerns (examples):
- Missed delivery on OTP batching work (deadline: 2026-12-15). PR left unaddressed after two review cycles; caused downstream delays in dedupe jobs.
- Slack escalations: dropped commitments to partner squad without notifying stakeholders (20XX-12-20 thread).
- Quality regressions in model integration tests (repeated configuration regressions).

Plan (immediate):
- Start date: 2027-01-20. Duration: 4 weeks.
- Weekly 1:1 check-ins (Olga <-> Jordan) every Wednesday at 10:00 PST; weekly status email to this thread with evidence attached.
- Specific, measurable goals in attached improvement_plan (deliverables, acceptance criteria, and examples).
- Training: schedule with Marcus for code-review standards + Monica to coordinate pairing sessions for two afternoons (noted in plan).

Deliverables & measurements:
- Ship OTP batching fixes with green CI and two peer reviews by 2027-02-10.
- Close three small open tickets assigned to Jordan and document steps in the ticket comments.
- Demonstrate stable CI runs for three consecutive runs.

Immediate asks for recipients:
- Laura: please confirm the timeline and whether additional executive alignment is needed for this pre-PIP approach.
- Marcus: confirm availability for two pairing sessions and expected capacity.
- Monica / PeopleOps: note any compliance or documentation needs (Ill keep HR looped).

Attachments: 20270120-improvement_plan-jh.docx; 20270120-weekly_checkin_template.xlsx

I will post the first weekly check-in next Wednesday and attach notes.

Thanks,

Olga Petrov

Thanks, Olga.

I reviewed the attached plan. The approach looks reasonable and humane — I appreciate the emphasis on measurable outcomes and pairing support rather than jumping straight to PIP. A couple quick notes:

- Timeline: 4 weeks is acceptable given the nature of the deliverables; please escalate earlier if risk of regression remains after two weeks.
- Evidence: please keep short, concrete notes in the ticket comments and include screenshots/log snippets where relevant.
- Tone guidance: when documenting performance conversations, use facts, impact, and clear next steps. Avoid subjective language.

I authorize this pre-PIP coaching approach. If at any point you and PeopleOps recommend moving to a formal PIP, loop me and include the evidence packet.

Also, include an explicit check-in with Jordans skip-level before week-3 so we can surface any blockers.

Laura
